items.title: Why Nvidia's purchase of Hugging Face is an 'important strategic move'
items.summary: Nvidia (NVDA) will be buying open-weight AI company Hugging Face for $12.9 billion. Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley and BD8 Capital Partners, LLC CEO Barbara Doran to discuss what this means for Nvidia's standing in the AI ecosystem as it aims to become more than just a chip supplier.

items.title: NVIDIA (NVDA)’s Hugging Face Deal Tests the Next Phase of its AI Strategy
items.summary: NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA) has agreed to acquire Hugging Face for approximately $12.93 billion, making it one of Nvidia’s largest acquisitions. The deal gives Nvidia a much stronger position in open-source/open-weight AI, an area gaining traction because developers can customize models and potentially deploy them at lower costs than proprietary alternatives.
